from datetime import datetime
from cronx import next_fire, _match
# strictly after: exact match excluded
assert next_fire('* *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,0)) == datetime(2026,1,1,10,1), next_fire('* *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,0))
# seconds truncated
assert next_fire('* *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,0,30)) == datetime(2026,1,1,10,1), next_fire('* *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,0,30))
# same-day
assert next_fire('30 10', datetime(2026,1,1,10,0)) == datetime(2026,1,1,10,30)
# next-day
assert next_fire('0 0', datetime(2026,1,1,10,0)) == datetime(2026,1,2,0,0)
# step
assert next_fire('*/15 *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,7)) == datetime(2026,1,1,10,15)
assert next_fire('*/15 *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,15)) == datetime(2026,1,1,10,30)
# wrap range minute 50-10
assert _match('50-10',0,59) == set(list(range(50,60))+list(range(0,11)))
assert next_fire('50-10 *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,11)) == datetime(2026,1,1,10,50)
assert next_fire('50-10 *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,55)) == datetime(2026,1,1,10,56)
# wrap hour 22-2
assert _match('22-2',0,23) == set([22,23,0,1,2])
assert next_fire('0 22-2', datetime(2026,1,1,3,0)) == datetime(2026,1,1,22,0)
assert next_fire('0 22-2', datetime(2026,1,1,23,30)) == datetime(2026,1,2,0,0)
# list
assert next_fire('5,10 *', datetime(2026,1,1,10,5)) == datetime(2026,1,1,10,10)
# midnight wrap
assert next_fire('0 0', datetime(2026,1,1,0,0)) == datetime(2026,1,2,0,0)
# brute-force cross-check vs naive scan on several exprs
import random
for expr in ['* *','*/15 9-17','50-10 22-2','5,35 8,20','*/20 */3','0 0']:
    for h in [0,8,22,23]:
        for m in [0,5,59]:
            after = datetime(2026,3,15,h,m,45)
            got = next_fire(expr, after)
            assert got > after and got.second==0 and got.microsecond==0, (expr,after,got)
            # no earlier match strictly after
            t = after.replace(second=0,microsecond=0)+__import__('datetime').timedelta(minutes=1)
            from cronx import _match as mm
            mins = mm(expr.split()[0],0,59); hrs = mm(expr.split()[1],0,23)

                t += __import__('datetime').timedelta(minutes=1)
